faqs.q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Bloomington, MN?
faqs.a: Bathroom remodels in Bloomington typically range from $8,000 to $25,000 depending on scope. A basic refresh runs $8,000–$12,000, a mid-range remodel $12,000–$18,000, and a full luxury remodel $18,000–$30,000+. We provide free in-home estimates.

faqs.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
faqs.a: Most bathroom remodels take 2–4 weeks from demo to final walkthrough. Simple updates like vanity and tile replacement can be completed in 1–2 weeks. Full gut-and-remodel projects may take 3–5 weeks.

faqs.q: Do you handle permits for bathroom remodels in Bloomington?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle all necessary permits for your bathroom remodel through the City of Bloomington Building Division. Permit requirements vary based on scope of work.

faqs.q: Can you add a walk-in shower where a tub was?
faqs.a: Absolutely — this is one of our most popular projects. We convert standard tubs to walk-in showers or full tub-to-shower conversions with custom tile, glass enclosures, and barrier-free designs.

faqs.q: Do you serve Minneapolis and surrounding suburbs?
faqs.a: Yes — we serve Bloomington, Minneapolis, Edina, Richfield, Eden Prairie, Burnsville, and the greater South Metro Twin Cities area.
